value.description: The stored value as a number — present ONLY when it is exactly representable as one. A config Value component holds a uint256 and several fields PACK eight uint32s into it; coerced with Number(), one such field served 1.347997333357532e+68. A value that does not fit is ABSENT here rather than wrong (§1.2). Unchanged for every field where it ever meant anything.

valueRaw.description: The stored value VERBATIM, as a decimal string, always present on the scalar form. For a packed field this is the only honest scalar reading; `--array` unpacks it.
